sentences.en: The townscape changed dramatically after the new park was built.
sentences.zh: 建了新公园之后，市镇风光大不相同了。

sentences.en: From the hill, you can see the picturesque townscape below.
sentences.zh: 从山上可以看到下面风景如画的市镇风光。

sentences.en: The artist was inspired by the quaint townscape for her painting.
sentences.zh: 艺术家受到那个古朴市镇风光的启发，创作了这幅画。
